subject.title: fix(searxng): fail closed on unresolved base url refs

question: Should an explicitly configured SearXNG `baseUrl` that is unavailable or invalid fail before network access instead of falling back to `SEARXNG_BASE_URL`?
rationale: Both outcomes are technically coherent, but the PR deliberately changes the upgrade contract for existing configurations that may have relied on ambient fallback after a configured SecretRef failed.

options.title: Accept fail-closed configuration
options.body: Approve the PR direction so explicit endpoint intent always wins and unavailable configuration produces an actionable error.

options.title: Preserve compatibility fallback
options.body: Require the PR to retain ambient fallback or propose an opt-in strict mode if existing deployments should continue searching after explicit resolution fails.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed configuration
recommendation.body: Approve the PR direction so explicit endpoint intent always wins and unavailable configuration produces an actionable error.
